description: This Java source file defines the 'SubjectsModified' event class within the Eclipse Ditto project. It models an event emitted after modifications to 'Subjects' within a policy, providing serialization/deserialization, accessors, and object management methods.

classes.name: SubjectsModified
classes.description: An immutable event class indicating that subjects within a policy have been modified, including serialization/deserialization support and accessors for related data.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new instance of SubjectsModified with specified parameters, with deprecated overload accepting String policyId.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Deserializes a SubjectsModified event from a JSON string or object, with the associated headers.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Returns the label of the policy entry associated with the event.

methods.name: setRevision
methods.description: Creates a new SubjectsModified instance with an updated revision.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Creates a new SubjectsModified instance with updated headers.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Serializes the event's payload into a JSON object.
